simple.meaning: נָסַח (nâçach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to tear away.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Deuteronomy, Psalms, Proverbs, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:63. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָסַח (H5255).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָסַח (nâçach) / H5255 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:63, Psalms 52:7, Proverbs 2:22, Proverbs 15:25 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

definitions.full: H5255. nasach [ נָסַח ] verb pull or tear away (Late Hebrew נְסַח ᵑ7 נָסַח, both remove ; Assyrian nasâ—u = Biblical Hebrew, so Old Aramaic נסח Cook 82 Lzb 323 ; Arabic annul, supersede, change by substitution, copy ; compare Assyrian nis—u, nus—u , extract , excerpt Dl HWB 472 Meissn ZA iv (1889), 267 ; Late Hebrew נָסְחָה , Nabataean נסחת id. , also Aramaic נוסחא (whence Arabic ) Hoffm ZMG xxxii. 760 compare Frä 251 ; Syriac copy ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular י יִסַּח גֵּאִים ׳בְּית Prov 15:25 the house of proud men will ׳י tear down ; מֵאֹהֶל וְיִסָּֽחֲךָ Psa 52:7 yea, he [ ׳י ] shall tear thee away, without a tent ; 3 masculine plural מִן יִסְּחוּ Prov 2:22 transgressors shall (men) tear away from the land (read perhaps יִנָָּֽסְחוּ shall be torn away ; || יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ ; compare Ges § 144 , 3b. R Da Synt. § 108. b ). Niph`al Perfect 2masculine plural consecutive הָאֲדָמָה מֵעַל וְנִסַּחְתֶּם Deut 28:63 and ye shall be torn away from off the land. מַסָּח 2Kin 11:6 , see above [ נְסַח ] verb pull away ( ᵑ7 ; see Biblical Hebrew); — Hithpe`el be pulled away: Imperfect 3masculine singular יִתְנְסַךְ Ezra 6:11 ( מִן ).
